{{Quote|Somehow, the Massassi script, with hooks and barbs on each glyph, seemed more menacing than any curses they could call down.|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>}}
'''Massassi''' was an [[Writing/Legends|alphabet]] used by<ref name="Written" /> the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]], the [[Massassi (language)|Massassi]]-[[Language/Legends|speaking]]<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> warrior class of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]].{{Fact}}

[[Xenographologist]]s discovered that the alphabet had ties to the simplified component of [[High Sith]] writing.<ref name="Written" /> Inside the [[Great Temple (Korriban)|Great Temple]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the walls of a mausoleum were covered in the Massassi inscriptions<ref name="Dark Lords 3" /> as were the [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Temple]]s on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Written" />
